question: After the Battle of Plassey 1757, who from the British East India Company, became Baron of Plassey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Robert Clive.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Robert Clive:-**

 
 
• He was a British general and statesman who played a key role in the establishment of British rule in India.
 
• He is best known for his victory at the Battle of Plassey in 1757, which gave the British East India Company control of the Bengal Presidency.
 
• **The Baron of Plassey was Robert Clive, 1st Baron Clive of Plassey, (Hence option 1 is correct).**
 
• **Clive served as Governor of Bengal twice, and during his second term he implemented a number of reforms that helped to consolidate British rule.**
 
• He also expanded the British Empire in India by conquering new territories.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Warren Hastings:-**

 
 
• **He was the first Governor-General of Bengal and is considered one of the most controversial figures in British colonial history. **
 
• He was a brilliant administrator and diplomat, but he was also accused of corruption and tyranny.
 
 
 
• **John Laird Mair Lawrence:-**
 
 
• He was an English-born Ulsterman who became a prominent British Imperial statesman.
 
• **He served as the Viceroy of India from 1864 to 1869.**
 
 
 
• **Charles James Napier:-**
 
 
• **He was a British general who is best known for his conquest of the Sindh province in India in 1843. **
 
• During his time as Governor, Napier introduced a number of reforms, including:
 
 
• Abolishing slavery.
 
• Reforming the tax system.
 
• Building new roads and irrigation canals.
 
• Establishing a new judicial system.
